sermon.title: Leaders
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer lays out God’s chain of command—God, Christ, then family, civil government, trade and the church—and each leader’s responsibilities. Christ is head of the church; civil leaders are servants; the family provides; the church teaches truth and makes disciples. Responsible family leaders produce good leaders everywhere, and believers are to rule over sin.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Joash called “king of Israel” (he reigned over Judah, 2 Chronicles 24); “11 judges” in the book of Judges; Romans 13:4 and 1 Timothy 5:8 are attached as context only. Unverified figures as spoken: over 50% of income paid in taxes; 400,000 smoking deaths a year; 54% of Americans with an STD; Sweden’s army vs Mexico’s. Political content kept as spoken: Trump on punishing abortion, Hillary, Bernie Sanders, Cruz “deceptive,” Bush stimulus, Obama and military sexual assault. Personal anecdotes: forced psychiatric counseling after a 1980s La Habra church split; a woman trying to run the church; polygamous convert in Ghana.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Heed the voice of the people in all that they say to you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected Me, that I should not reign over them.
But his citizens hated him, and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We will not have this man to reign over us.’
As for My people, children are their oppressors, And women rule over them. O My people! Those who lead you cause you to err, And destroy the way of your paths.”

faqs.question: When are you an adult in the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says at 20 years old you’re responsible to take care of yourself.

faqs.question: Do men have a right to boss women around?
When should you start a family?
faqs.answer: After you have a career that can provide for it.

faqs.question: Is America’s problem Democrat or Republican?
Whose church is it?
faqs.answer: Jesus’—the pastor is delegated to serve it.

faqs.question: Should you follow a leader who isn’t following Christ?
faqs.answer: No—follow me as I follow Christ.

faqs.question: Who provides medical care, food and shelter?
faqs.answer: The family—God didn’t give those to civil authorities.

faqs.question: How do you rule over sin?
How do you get answers for people?
faqs.answer: Get in the teaching studies and go out and share.
